In the beginning, I recommended this game a lot, and I honestly want to continue to do so. I like most of its gameplay, visuals, music and more. In addition, the cosmetic and gameplay customization is simply amazing. I don't easily get addicted to a game, but this game managed to hook me. You can see my proof of that by looking at the hours i've put in. 

But Warframe has been steadily slipping into a downwards spiral. A spiral of extreme grind, feature creep and ignoring the community. Some new content it gets ranges from decent to good, but even this is overshadowed by problems. I think DE just throws content at the game and seeing what sticks, completely neglecting the buggy, incomplete and boring features that don't. This is on top of an extremely heavy grind and a general disrespect to the player's time.

The game got some ‘band-aid fixes’ over its lifespan, but overall it's steadily going downhill. It's gotten to the point where I can’t enjoy the game anymore. Because of the grind it forces you through if you want to get anything done in this game, Warframe as a whole just feels like a giant chore. Every update also makes sure that the grind never stops coming and keeps getting worse. New resources, equipment, gameplay-types and modes, etc. There's no end-game or purpose, there's only [i]the grind[/i] (... and fashion). An example of the disrespect to one's time: 'host migrations' are very common here. It isn't just annoying waiting for the migration to be done, it also often causes you to lose [i]all[/i] rewards and progress of that mission.

So much of the game’s content is locked behind time walls, pay walls, RNG walls and grind walls. Now I get it to some degree, but Warframe has crossed that degree [i]and then some[/i]. With low drop chances and lots of tedious and repetitive missions, the forced grind just becomes ridiculous. This is even worse for new players, who have to grind everything from [b]scratch[/b]. Not only that, but there is so little in Warframe in terms of tutorials and information, that new players (and at times even veteran players) will often find themselves overwhelmed, confused and lost by the sheer amount of random content and features.

I just can't recommend Warframe, mainly because it just doesn't respect the player's time or effort in the slightest. Mind-numbing grind, a horrible new player experience, a non-existent end-game, balancing issues (they nerf everything), tons of bugs that cause you to lose time and more, and way too many forgotten and/or broken modes and features.

[b]Pro's:[/b]
 + Great visuals.
 + Great audio and music.
 + Great gameplay.
 + Amazing customization.
 + Lore is mostly decent and entertaining, though has gone downhill since 2023 or so.
 + Has a mostly decent player community.
 + Mostly free to play.

[b]Cons:[/b]
 - Enemies tend to be nothing more than bullet sponges capable of one-shotting players. Bosses are never interesting and mostly focus on invulnerability phases.
 - Trading and Recruiting are tedious and contain nothing but walls of ever-moving text.
 - Overpriced Market Items, Trading prices and Platinum prices. Platinum is so pricey that the only moment you should buy it is when you recieve a 50%+ discount coupon from login rewards.
 - Way too many unnecessary features (a.k.a feature creep). Developers forget about old content and balance issues in favor of constantly pumping out new content.
 - Lack of ingame tutorials/information, to the point where one almost exclusively relies on the Warframe Wiki and other external sources.
 - The game's story and tone has gone downhill to such a degree that I can barely recognize Warframe anymore. I personally experience quite a bit of cringe at much of the new stuff.
 - Connectivity issues, host migrations, lag and bugs are very common.
 - The grind is real! Warframe in many ways shows that it does not respect your time at all.

By far the best FTP game I've played...  GFX and game play are outstanding, lots of frames / weapons to choose from so there's  plenty of options to suit anyones play style.  Their mod system even takes takes it one step further.  The customization of your warframe has endless possabilities.  

For a small team they really do a nice job and rival any other game I've played (AAA or Indie) for quality and support.  If there's a glitch they come out with a fix quickly (like minutes to a few hours).  They constantly come out with new weapons and warframes or prime warframes and have slowly been creating new story quests and some of the latest ones are really fun.

My only gripe is they need new world content...  If you play for a long time it gets borring because the constant grind in the same areas for prime parts (in a area called the void).  My friends and I probably have done all the void missions 100s of times (we have all the primes) and it's chore after 20 runs on either mission.  You're sent there for every prime part and you must do them over and over in hopes that the end reward is the part you need.  Some maps can take upwards of 50+ tries to get and each attempt can take anywhere from 20 to 40+ mins depending if you want to save your keys and go for the seccond round rotation.  It would be more fun if there was new content when new primes come out for instance.  Or even if you could get them on the planet maps because once you play through them you rarely go back to them other than when events or alerts pop up.  There's so many cool maps that they could use instead of going to just the void.

Bottom line it's worth the DL and playthrough.  New players will have a blast and it will keep you interested for a long time.  Just be prepaired for a grind when you start maxing your frames.
This is the best game on the market. It is free and not p2w you can get plat with trading.No reason not to try it .

Amazing, nothing short of amazing. I've got almost 2000 hours in game, and I'm still not bored of it. If you're willing to work for your progress, this game never gets old. Highly recommended. 

I still play this game all time, by the way, I just don't play the Steam version outside acquiring Tennogen often as the overlay gets in the way on my control scheme for Warframe and I don't want to change the shortcut just for Warframe, but, whatever, I'm rambling. Game rocks.
